---
title: "Memo"
subtitle: "Notes, minutes, agendas and briefs of one to three pages."
description: "The memo type of the mcanouil extension: its four kinds, the banner fields of each kind, and the body conventions for minutes and agendas."
---

A memo starts with a full width banner: the kind label, the title and the banner fields, on the ground of the preset.
A band at the bottom of every page holds the footer slots.
A memo has no cover and no contents.
It renders in `mcanouil-typst` and `mcanouil-html`.

```yaml
title: "Steering committee"
format:
  mcanouil-typst: default
  mcanouil-html: default
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: memo
    kind: minutes
    memo:
      date-time: "11 Nov 2026, 14:00"
      present: "MC, AA, BW"
      absent: "CD"
```

## Kinds and banner fields

Put the banner fields under `extensions: mcanouil: memo:`.

| `kind` | Banner fields |
| --- | --- |
| `note` (default) | `to`, `from`, `date` |
| `minutes` | `date-time`, `present`, `absent` |
| `agenda` | `date-time`, `place`, `participants` |
| `brief` | `date`, `audience`, `purpose` |

: The banner fields of each memo kind, in the order they show. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[24,76]"}

If you do not set `date`, the banner uses the document `date`.
If you do not set `date-time`, the banner uses `memo: date`, then the document `date`.
A field without a value does not show.
In the PDF, the banner fields are a tagged table.

## Minutes

Write the decisions as text and the actions as a table with three columns: action, owner, due date.

```markdown
## Decisions

The committee approves the revised plan.

## Actions

| Action     | Owner | Due    |
|------------|-------|--------|
| Draft plan | AA    | 18 Nov |
| Book room  | MC    | 20 Nov |
```

## Agenda

Write the agenda as a numbered list, one item per line.
Put the duration and the owner of an item in brackets at the end of the line.
Both are optional.

```markdown
1. Welcome and apologies (5 min, MC)
2. Review of the last actions (10 min, AA)
3. Release plan (20 min, BW)
4. Any other business (5 min)
```

## Brief

Write a brief as short sections, each with a level 2 heading.

## Headings

Memo body headings have no numbers.
A memo can start at `##`: the format shifts the headings and gives no warning.

## Footer band in HTML

In `mcanouil-html`, the footer band shows only when at least one footer slot has content.
If all three slots are empty, the HTML memo has no band.
The PDF always has the band.
